label: List Workflows
title: List Workflows
subtitle: Returns the list of enabled workflows in the current project, with IDs, names, and descriptions. Used for workflow discovery.
whenToUse: Agents call this to discover what automated workflows are available before triggering one. Useful when the user asks about available automations.

methods.name: List Workflows
methods.description: Returns all enabled workflows with their metadata (ID, name, description). Disabled workflows are excluded.

mediaCaption: A list of available workflows returned by the tool, showing workflow names and descriptions
